name: Web-triage isolation cell for untrusted content
summary: a fetch-only subagent (web fetch + web search, no shell, no files, no other tools) that reads every piece of untrusted external content — pages, search results, release notes, issues, forums, pasted URLs — and returns a fixed-schema digest with an INJECTION SIGNALS section; the main session never fetches or pastes raw web text
requires: a harness with subagents and per-agent tool allowlists
retires: the judgment call 'is this page safe to read into my context?' on every fetch
